subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, and should it depend on the Gateway principal work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43903 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92367?
rationale: Per-user token accounting is identity, billing, and authorization sensitive, and the current usage telemetry plus origin metadata are not enough to safely define who can view whose activity or spend.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Define a Gateway/Core accounting principal and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and Dashboard around it.

options.title: Wait For Gateway Principal Design
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the multi-token/scoped-principal issues settle the caller identity model.

options.title: External Reporting For Now
options.body: Document per-gateway separation, trusted-proxy/Pinchy-style front layers, or external usage tools as the supported path until core multi-user accounting is designed.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Define a Gateway/Core accounting principal and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and Dashboard around it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across usage summaries, shared usage/auth helpers, and prior maintainer-facing review of this accounting boundary.
